music.prompt: Sunny balearic disco at exactly 120 BPM for a light, airy product comparison motion graphics film: a breathy flute riff, lush synth strings, a bouncy funky bassline, crisp handclaps and a shaker; optimistic and breezy, no vocals. It starts immediately with the flute riff, a shaker and a light kick (0 to 9 seconds, floating and curious, no bass), rises with strings and a soft swell from 9 seconds, stops for one beat at 11.2 seconds, then drops at 11.5 seconds into the full groove with the bouncy bass and handclaps, which carries all the way to the end with extra percussion from 23 seconds. It ends cleanly on a downbeat at 40 seconds with no big final hit and no fade.
